source_row.extraction_instructions: Sitefinity (not WordPress) card list, 8 per page over 3 pages, upcoming first. Card: <section class=search-news__result> with title link (internal page or external Cvent link), <date> with <sup> ordinals, category button. Detail pages are free-form blurbs (Date / Location / Event information / Registration fees: / Find out more and register) inside one ASP.NET <form>; fees are written as prose (Consultant: GBP 120, Trainee: GBP 80; 'GBP 500 (Early Bird before ...)'). Many pages only link to the organiser's own site, stored as organiser_url.

registry_comment: BAPRAS events: Sitefinity listing via WordPress family base; bespoke prose fee/location parser and organiser_url

spot_check.site_says: Dissection and microsurgery places GBP 1950; observers from GBP 250
From GBP 76 (nurse member) to GBP 184 (consultant member - early bird); Royal College of Physicians, London
30 Oct - 1 Nov 2026; Consultant 850, Trainee 600, Medical student 300

concerns: Site shows 19 cards over 3 pages; 17 emitted: one past event (3rd ICOPLAST 2025) dropped, and the Cvent link 'BAPRAS Congress 2026 - 80th Anniversary' dropped as a duplicate of the congress's own page (same dates). AEC 6.1 Lower Limb Reconstruction (Cvent, 8-9 Oct 2026) is included but ends today; Cvent pages are JS-rendered so its detail is thin.

Six events have no fee on bapras.org.uk but the page links to an organiser site that does (verified by hand: capras876.com shows USD passes 29/40/68, nstcsurg.org shows GBP 625, healthcareconferencesuk.co.uk shows BADS pricing, BAPRAS Congress and PLASTA are Cvent). organiser_url is set so the explorer follows it; the harness flags these as PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK, which is expected. Hands-on Microsurgery (Lahore) gives only a phone contact: no fee exists. Surgical Research Society: external site only.
Melanoma page link text says 2026 but its href points at the 2025 URL; the visible URL is stored as organiser_url.

Site typos copied faithfully: tier label 'June 2025 Course' on the June 2027 course; 'Data:' for 'Date:' on the melanoma page. The 'Hands-on Microsurgery' card says 2-6 Nov but its page says '02 - 60 November': listing dates kept.

Venue city is left empty where the page names only a venue (RCS England, Newcastle Surgical Training Centre, RVI Culture Centre): no city on the page, none invented. CAPRAS (Jamaica per capras876.com) gives only 'Ocean Coral Springs, Trelawny'.

Sitefinity wraps every page in one <form>, so the base's chrome stripping removes the whole body; handled in the subclass by renaming form tags. A base option to keep <form> content would remove this override.

Coverage checklist: (1) multi-day: listing ranges kept as end_date; (2) external fee links: organiser_url set from the Register/Visit link; (3) image fee tables: none seen; (4) same-site registration sub-pages: see per-source note; (5) two-hop: organiser_url handed to explorer; (6) poster competitions: none; (7) call-for-papers/portals left to the merge step (harness coverage shows SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE as expected); (8) no CTA text in tier labels.
